verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege API credentials are a fair question for an authentication and credential product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers human sign-in: push approvals, OTP codes, passkeys, Verified IDs and backups. Nothing shows the app can issue scoped API tokens or credentials for an agent, and the probes found no OpenAPI or API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
